recommendations.title: Restore or redirect /website-development-perth
recommendations.note: Highest-impression page on the site (15 impressions, position 28.9) and the only page ranking for the Perth web development terms. Returns 404; Google reports it Submitted and indexed with a successful crawl on 2026-09-05, so it broke on or after that date. Restore at the same URL, or 301 to /website-development and remove it from the sitemap. Must be settled before the next recrawl drops it.

recommendations.title: Audit the sitemap against what actually resolves
recommendations.note: One of nine checked URLs is a submitted 404. The routing change that broke it may have broken URLs that have no impressions yet to reveal them.

recommendations.title: Give the 404 template its own title and metadata
recommendations.note: The error template inherits the homepage title and meta description, so a broken URL presents to a crawler as a legitimate page. Add a distinct title and a noindex directive.

recommendations.title: Build the dealer product pages out to match the service pages
recommendations.note: Both dealer-side queries sit past position 80. /dealership-website-builder is 455 words against 1,661 for /seo and 1,050 for /automation. The two pages that rank respectably are the two with substance on them.

recommendations.title: Leave the rest alone until there is data
recommendations.note: 26 impressions cannot distinguish an underperforming page from an unseen one. Tuning against these figures optimises against noise and destroys the baseline.

experiments.hypothesis: Restoring /website-development-perth holds its index position, and the page recovers impressions for the three Perth web development terms rather than losing them at the next recrawl.
experiments.note: 15 impressions, position 28.9, 0 clicks, page tier. Read no earlier than 2026-11-14: far enough out to clear a recrawl cycle on a site Google currently visits about fortnightly. An earlier look shows whether the URL resolves, which is worth knowing, but does not answer the question.
